items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: Joe E. Lewis was a comedian out in Cicero at that time. He used to come by a lot of times by the Grand Terrace.

ctx.x: That's right. And Joe E. Lewis was a comedian out in Cicero at that time. He used to come by a lot of times by the Grand Terrace. They all used to come by there a lot. Joe Louis, the fighter, he was coming up there and he used to come by a lot. And the reason Joe E. Lewis said he named himself with the E. was because he didn't want to get mixed up with Joe Louis, the fighter. The names were spelled different, Lewis, but they were pronounced the same, see.
